(4) The budgeting of programs and activities as referred to in Article 28 letter b, is implemented through general budget policy as stipulated in the APBD.
(5) The implementation of programs and activities as referred to in Article 28 letter c, is implemented through:
a. implementation of programs and activities as contained in the regional apparatus budget document;

CHAPTER X
COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION
Article 30
(1) The community may participate in the implementation of empowerment and protection of women.
(2) Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be realized through:
a. actions to provide information and/or report violence against women to law enforcement or the authorities, or participate in handling acts of violence against women.

7.3.rationale: The original Indonesian Pasal 32(2)(f) explicitly includes “bantuan internasional” (international assistance) when coordinating participation of the business sector and other institutions for women’s empowerment and protection. This is a direct reference to international support/donor involvement (even if not a dedicated funding line). The judge’s “Yes” is supported by the Indonesian text; therefore the golden “No” appears incorrect.
